questions: Does the historical Nexus remediation retain genuine relational competence?
Did it improve Nexus for the reason originally claimed?
Which gains were caused by nuisance direction / action-ID behaviour?
Is Nexus limited by policy logic, missing relational/spatial state, or both?
Is any existing Nexus remediation worth preserving?
role: REQUALIFICATION_ONLY: no Nexus redesign, no policy training, no deployable use of privileged features

TARGET.source: observed canonical state (entity kind/hostile/critical, observed relationship edges)

NEXUS.source: Nexus diagnosis over the observed state (the rank of the action type in the active V1 preference order; the V2 PROTECT gate)

GEOMETRY.source: Stage 3F.6-P.1A-SYM deployable candidate fields (zeros for actions that do not move the actor)

REASON_X_TYPE.source: observed Nexus threat-driven flag multiplied by TYPE

PRIV_MOVEMENT.source: kernel entity positions: change of nearest distance from the actor to each entity class if the action moves the actor (P.1A-SYM privilegedRelations)

PRIV_TARGET.source: kernel entity positions and objective membership for the targeted entity

forbidden: successor state (except the declared ONESTEP diagnostic)

partitions.DEV: P.1D DEV: fits the diagnostic scorers and fixes the regime cut points (medians)
partitions.CAL: P.1D CAL: descriptive only (no selection is needed: every scorer specification is fixed here)
partitions.FRESH_HOLDOUT: PRIMARY confirmatory: 6000 rows from the newly declared HOLDOUT seed space
partitions.FRESH_OOD: PRIMARY robustness: 6000 rows from the newly declared OOD seed space (levels 6-7)
partitions.generation: only after this plan, the open-phase report and every evaluation file are committed unchanged at HEAD

NX_RELATIONAL_ONLY.question: can Nexus's own relational inputs (no actor geometry) support a better decision than Nexus's fixed rule? (the Nexus-scope repair test)

NX_DEPLOYABLE.question: what can every deployable input, including the P.1A-SYM actor geometry Nexus never reads, support? (deployable ceiling)

NX_PRIVILEGED.question: does kernel entity geometry unlock the decision?

NX_PRIV_MOVEMENT_ONLY.question: is the gain in where movement leads (action semantics relative to entities)?

NX_PRIV_TARGET_ONLY.question: is the gain in where targeted entities are (relational spatial context)?

NX_DEPLOYABLE_ONESTEP.question: does a one-step successor reward suffice?

NX_PRIVILEGED_ONESTEP.question: does one-step information add to entity geometry?

scorers.model: Stage 3F.6-P.1A-SYM conditional logit (fitCandidateLogit, unchanged): set-valued optimal target, DEV standardisation, lr 0.1, l2 1e-3, 2000 iterations; candidates = every distinct legal action
scorers.roleOfPrivileged: upper-bound diagnostics only; never a deployable result

perStrategy: top-1 accuracy (chosen action in the optimal set; uniform over score ties)
type accuracy (chosen type is an optimal type)
target accuracy (chosen action optimal given its type is an optimal type)
PROTECT selection rate, PROTECT precision, PROTECT-optimal rate
confidence calibration where the policy emits non-constant confidence; scorer Brier / ECE
metrics.comparisons: paired on identical episodes (policy-proposing rows for policy comparisons): top-1 and normalized-regret differences with 1000-resample bootstrap 95% CIs
metrics.materiality: MATERIAL = top-1 gain >= 0.05 with CI lower > 0 and normalized regret not significantly worse (P.1A-SYM materialGain, unchanged)

observed.OBJECTIVE_RELATION: a legal action targets an observed critical entity
observed.RESOURCE_RELATION: a legal action targets an observed RESOURCE-kind entity
observed.THREAT_DRIVEN: the observed Nexus diagnosis is threat-driven

oracleDiagnostic.COSTLY_ACTION_OPTIMAL: no optimal action has declared cost 0

relationalValue.rule: GENUINE_RELATIONAL_VALUE for a Nexus policy when, in at least one OBSERVED regime with >= 200 proposing rows on FRESH_HOLDOUT, its top-1 exceeds BOTH the uniform-legal expectation and RESOURCE by a MATERIAL margin, the same comparison has CI lower > 0 on FRESH_OOD, and the policy has no replicated nuisance dependence
relationalValue.oracleRegimes: reported as conditional competence (where Nexus is right when the oracle says a relational action is optimal); never sufficient on their own, because they are not observable

tests: action-ID permutation (8 seeds) and reversal (P.1E evidence, unchanged)
chosen MOVE direction share and accuracy by chosen direction
target-ID ordering (targeted choices changed by identity relabelling)
shortcutAudit.flags: P.1E factorGap (orientation, direction) and pairedFlag (ID order vs permuted mean, D4 twin); NUISANCE_DEPENDENCE requires the flag on BOTH FRESH_HOLDOUT and FRESH_OOD
shortcutAudit.candidateShuffle: any choice change under a pure order shuffle is an ordering defect and is reported

historicalClaims.C1_PROTECT_BIAS_MAIN_CAUSE: SURVIVES if V1 PROTECT selection share >= 0.8 AND PROTECT carries >= 0.8 of V1 regret on FRESH_HOLDOUT; PARTIALLY if one holds; else INVALIDATED
historicalClaims.C2_TARGET_NOT_MAIN_DEFECT: SURVIVES if P(V1 choice optimal | chosen type is an optimal type) >= 0.9; PARTIALLY if >= 0.7; else INVALIDATED
historicalClaims.C3_V2_STANDALONE_MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT: SURVIVES if V2 - V1 is MATERIAL on FRESH_HOLDOUT and FRESH_OOD both raw AND with both policies tie-randomised (ID-permuted means); PARTIALLY if material raw on FRESH_HOLDOUT but not tie-randomised or not on OOD; else INVALIDATED
historicalClaims.C4_V2_GAIN_FROM_MOVE_RESOURCE_COLLINEAR: SURVIVES if V2 MOVE share >= 0.5 AND V2 agreement with RESOURCE >= 0.5 on FRESH_HOLDOUT; PARTIALLY if one; else INVALIDATED
historicalClaims.C5_V2_REDUCES_POLICY_SET_VALUE: SURVIVES if oracle{RES,V2,OBJ,THR} top-1 < oracle{RES,V1,OBJ,THR} top-1 with paired CI upper < 0 on FRESH_HOLDOUT; else INVALIDATED
historicalClaims.C6_V2_WORSE_WHERE_V1_BEST: SURVIVES if on rows where V1 is in the best set of {RES,V1,OBJ,THR}, V2 top-1 < V1 top-1 with CI upper < 0 on FRESH_HOLDOUT; else INVALIDATED
historicalClaims.C7_V1_VALUE_FROM_GREEDY_COLLINEARITY: SURVIVES if V1 agreement with GREEDY >= 0.5 on FRESH_HOLDOUT; PARTIALLY if >= 0.25; else INVALIDATED
historicalClaims.C8_REMEDIATION_REQUIRES_MISSING_REPRESEN: SURVIVES if NX_PRIVILEGED - NX_DEPLOYABLE is MATERIAL on FRESH_HOLDOUT and FRESH_OOD; PARTIALLY if on one; else INVALIDATED
historicalClaims.C9_V1_THREAT_REGIME_INSENSITIVE: SURVIVES if the V1 top-1 gap between HOSTILE_PRESENT and not does not flag (factorGap) on FRESH_HOLDOUT; else INVALIDATED
historicalClaims.C10_ENTITY_TARGETED_ORACLE_NOT_MATERIAL: SURVIVES if, on rows with any legal entity-targeted action, the best entity-targeted action minus V1 is not MATERIAL on FRESH_HOLDOUT; else INVALIDATED
historicalClaims.C11_V2_SIMULATOR_FREE: SURVIVES if the V2 source and candidate hashes equal the historically certified ones (static re-verification; the dynamic poison probe is not re-run)
historicalClaims.C12_V1_PRESERVED: SURVIVES if the V1 source is unchanged and reproduces every stored choice (fidelity 1.0)

labels: REPRESENTATION_BLOCKED (NX_PRIVILEGED - NX_DEPLOYABLE MATERIAL on both fresh partitions)
POLICY_LOGIC_LIMITED (NX_RELATIONAL_ONLY - policy MATERIAL on both fresh partitions, policy-proposing rows)
REDESIGN_CANDIDATE (marginal oracle top-1 gain >= 0.02 and top-1 when best-available < 0.5; P.1E rule)
classification.marginalSet: {RESOURCE, OBJECTIVE, THREAT} plus the policy, on FRESH_HOLDOUT
classification.primary: first holding label in the order above; every holding label is reported

architecture.rule: OBSERVATION_INFRASTRUCTURE when REPRESENTATION_BLOCKED (the missing inputs are kernel observations no interface exposes); NEXUS co-owns when NX_PRIV_TARGET_ONLY - NX_DEPLOYABLE is MATERIAL (relational spatial context of targets); ACTION_SEMANTICS_INFRASTRUCTURE when NX_PRIV_MOVEMENT_ONLY - NX_DEPLOYABLE is MATERIAL (what an action does relative to entities); ARCHIMEDES when NX_PRIVILEGED_ONESTEP - NX_PRIVILEGED is MATERIAL (mechanistic effect); ORACLE is not assessed (no temporal diagnostic)
architecture.expert10: not considered unless an orthogonal capability fits no existing boundary; nine experts assumed

roadmap.HISTORICAL_P1_SURVIVES: true if every testable claim SURVIVES, false if none does, else PARTIAL
roadmap.GENUINE_RELATIONAL_VALUE_MEASURED: relationalValue holds for V1 or V2
roadmap.NEXUS_POLICY_REPAIR_JUSTIFIED: NX_RELATIONAL_ONLY is MATERIAL over V1 on both fresh partitions AND MATERIAL over RESOURCE on both (a repair within Nexus's relational inputs exists); neither a privileged gain nor a gain that needs actor geometry sets this
roadmap.SPATIAL_STATE_REQUIRED: NX_PRIVILEGED - NX_DEPLOYABLE MATERIAL on both fresh partitions
roadmap.ACTION_SEMANTICS_REQUIRED: NX_PRIV_MOVEMENT_ONLY - NX_DEPLOYABLE MATERIAL on FRESH_HOLDOUT, or carried true from P.1A-SYM
roadmap.TRANSITION_PREDICTION_REQUIRED: NX_PRIVILEGED_ONESTEP - NX_PRIVILEGED MATERIAL on both fresh partitions, or NX_DEPLOYABLE_ONESTEP - NX_DEPLOYABLE MATERIAL on both
roadmap.READY_FOR_STAGE3F6W_REQUALIFICATION: stage PASS (W consumes 3F.6-T, which is requalified)

preFreezeRevisions.when: after a dry run of the confirmatory code on CAL rows standing in for sealed data; no fresh row existed
preFreezeRevisions.observed: on CAL, NX_DEPLOYABLE (which includes the P.1A-SYM actor geometry) beat V1 and RESOURCE, which would have set NEXUS_POLICY_REPAIR_JUSTIFIED
preFreezeRevisions.problem: actor geometry is not a Nexus input and is not relational; a repair that needs it would make Nexus a movement policy, which is the role loss historical P.1 identified
preFreezeRevisions.change: added the deployable NX_RELATIONAL_ONLY scorer (Nexus relational inputs only) and based POLICY_LOGIC_LIMITED and NEXUS_POLICY_REPAIR_JUSTIFIED on it; NX_DEPLOYABLE is reported as the deployable ceiling including actor geometry
preFreezeRevisions.effect: makes the repair verdict stricter and closer to the question; no threshold changed

acceptance.PASS: every integrity check holds; a negative Nexus result is a valid PASS
FAIL: sealed data before the freeze commit

seedPlan.use: the first declared seed of each space, in canonical combination order; later seeds only if the first cannot fill 6000 admitted rows
priorSources: P.1D declared DEV 2001-2003, CAL 2011-2013, HOLDOUT 2021-2023, OOD 2031-2033 (HOLDOUT/OOD all consumed by P.1D, 3F.6-T-SYM and P.1A-SYM)
seedPlan.spareDevCalSeeds: P.1D DEV/CAL spares (2002, 2003, 2012, 2013) are DEV/CAL seeds and are not used as sealed seeds
seedPlan.declaredBefore: any partition from these seeds exists; chosen as the next unused decade block, not from any outcome
seedPlan.exclusion: a candidate whose record, world or topology hash is claimed anywhere in the P.1D corpus, the 3F.6-T-SYM fresh partitions or the P.1A-SYM fresh partitions, or earlier in this set, is rejected

references: PERFECT_SELECTOR over {RESOURCE, NEXUS, OBJECTIVE, THREAT} with V1 or V2 in the NEXUS slot
